decisions.reason: As a core safety-shoe line with another year of market learning behind it, it remains a worthwhile option and its survival so far is a positive signal against near-term withdrawal.
The comfort insole is inexpensive to keep available and, after Product C was removed, it still gives the firm a useful lower-commitment accessory option alongside its footwear range.
The ergonomic safety-shoe series fits the firm’s innovation positioning and core capabilities, so keeping it open remains the more valuable choice than abandoning it now.
Although firefighter and rescue boots serve a narrower niche, the product line still extends the firm’s protective-footwear competence and merits being kept while demand continues to clarify.
Because the moulded insole was presented as a flagship direction and complements the firm’s measurement and fit capabilities, management would be very unlikely to withdraw it within the next year.
